Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text only in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Chewbacca (Revised)]] (September 1998), before the Glossary. They also appear on [[Chewbacca (Reflections Foil)]] (Reflections foil, 12 January 2000).
